_about: The capability register: every capability the video engine has, across this repository, control-center and inspirationhouse, with what it is for, the production stage it serves, when its choice is made today, its status, and a keep, merge, retire or decide proposal (decide: an architecture call only Krish can make). The proposals are Krish's to decide; nothing here retires anything. Krish, 2026-11-10: "They need to be cleaned up and made modular and really clear as to what capability it is for and what part of the production process it is for, so that in the future we can build our own suite of capabilities that are unique." Seeded from the 10 Nov read-only map (docs/plans/2026-11-10-video-style-system/capability-map.md). Read it with python3 scripts/capabilities.py; check with --check; docs/CAPABILITIES.md is rendered from it.
